mapping.author: claude-mapper-fdn-m1
mapping.draft_py:
# Seeker's Folly (FDN) -- Choose one --
#  * Target opponent discards two cards.
#      M21 Liliana's Steward's "Target opponent discards a card" (the TARGET_OPPONENT discard move),
#      two cards as M21 Mind Rot's B5b-discard-target-2.
#  * Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.
#      ZNR Beyeen Veil's B9-opponents-get-pm-eot at -1/-1 (M21 Massacre Wurm's two-sided shrink).
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
        effect=Choose(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            options=(
                A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'cards': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=2),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(children=()),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.TARGET_OPPONENT),),
                    ),
                    'controller': ControllerRef.TARGET_OPPONENT,
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.TARGET_OPPONENT),
                    'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.TARGET_OPPONENT),
                }),
                A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                    'duration': DurationEot(),
                    'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QUnbounded(),
                        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                        filter=FAnd(
                            children=(
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                    'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.DECREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: • Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1 until end of turn.

mapping.notes: Choose(count 1): Liliana's Steward's TARGET_OPPONENT discard at Mind Rot's count 2; Beyeen Veil's opponents' creatures -1/-1 until end of turn. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: seekers_folly_opponent_chooses_two, seekers_folly_shrink_locks_in_its_creatures (CR 611.2c).
